tuition_policy.payment_rules: At least 50% must be paid upon contract signing prior to semester registration; remaining 50% by beginning of second semester.

state_grants.type: Republic of Kazakhstan State Educational Grant

spt_olympiad.name: SDU Proficiency Test (SPT)
spt_olympiad.description: Annual nationwide academic olympiad organized by SDU for 11th grade school & college graduates.
stages: Stage 2: Offline subject-matter testing in major Kazakhstan cities (March)

internal_discounts: Athlete and creative performance scholarship quotas

language_proficiency.preparatory_year: Students who score below the required English level are enrolled into SDU Foundation / Preparatory English School for 1 year.

required_documents.details: Original certificate of secondary school completion or college diploma with transcript supplement.
Electronic UNT certificate verifying threshold scores in core and profile subjects.
Copy of personal identification document with IIN.
Medical health form with attached fluorography film/report and vaccination record form 063-U.
IELTS / TOEFL certificate copy for exemption from the preparatory language year.

campus_features: Full suburban campus in Kaskelen with 14 hectares territory
On-campus student dormitories for boys and girls with 1000+ bed capacity
Sports complex with indoor football, basketball arena, gym, and outdoor stadium
24/7 library, cafeterias, food court, and medical center
campus_and_dormitory.dormitory_priority: Guaranteed priority for first-year regional and international students. Applications open in early August via student portal.
